1
Nkyea
1 # Yak 1.1 Petro, Yesu Kristo somafoɔ, de kɔma wɔn a wɔahwete kɔ Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia ne Bitinia no mu, amamfrafoɔ a wɔayi wɔn, 2#Rom 8.29 sɛdeɛ Agya Nyankopɔn nim a ɔnim dada no teɛ no, wɔ honhom ahoteɛ mu, de kɔ asoɔmmerɛ ne Yesu Kristo mogya dwira mu: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ mmorosoɔ nka mo.
Anidasoɔ a ɛwɔ nkwa mu
3Nhyira nka yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo Nyankopɔn ne Agya a ne mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso nti ɔnam Yesu Kristo sɔreɛ a ɔfiri awufoɔ mu sɔreeɛ no so awo yɛn foforɔ kɔ anidasoɔ a emu wɔ nkwa mu, 4#Kol 1.12 ne apɛgyadeɛ a ɛmporɔ, na ɛho nni dɛm, na ɛmpa mu, a wɔde asie ɔsoro ama mo 5#Yoh 10.28; 17.11 a wɔnam gyidie so wɛn mo wɔ Nyankopɔn tumi mu de kɔ nkwagyeɛ a wɔasiesie sɛ wɔrebɛyi no adie ɛberɛ a ɛdi akyire no mu.
6 # Rom 5.2; 2 Ko 4.17; 1 Pe 5.10 Ɛno mu na mo ho siane mo, mo a nnansa yi, sɛ ɛsɛ a, wɔho mo werɛ kakra, sɔhwɛ ahodoɔ bebree mu, 7#Mmb 17.3; Mal 3.3 na wɔahunu mo gyidie tɔtorɔtɔɔ sɛ ne boɔ yɛ den pii sene sika, a wɔsɔ hwɛ ogya mu, nanso ɛsɛeɛ, ama ayeyie ne anidie ne animuonyam, Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu. 8#Yoh 20.29; 2 Ko 5.7 Ɔno na monhunuu no, nanso modɔ no. Ɔno na monhunuu no seesei deɛ, nanso mogye no die, na mo ho siane mo anigyeɛ a ɛnni kabea a animuonyam wɔ mu mu, 9#Rom 6.22 sɛ monya mo gyidie akatua a ɛne mo kra nkwagyeɛ no. 10#Luk 10.24 Saa nkwagyeɛ no na adiyifoɔ a wɔhyɛɛ adom a ɛbɛba mo soɔ no ho nkɔm de too hɔ no, pɛeɛ na wɔpeepee mu. 11#Dwom 22; Yes 53 Wɔhwehwɛɛ berɛ ko ne berɛ ahodoɔ a Kristo honhom a ɛwɔ wɔn mu dii kan daa no adi faa n’amanehunu ne akyire animuonyam a ɛbɛba no ho.
Adiyifoɔ ne abɔfoɔ
12 # Efe 3.10 Wɔyi kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, ɛnyɛ wɔn ho nko na wɔsom, na mmom wɔsom mo fa nsɛm a seesei yɛbɔ no dawuro kyerɛ mo ne wɔn a wɔnam Honhom Kronkron a wɔsomaa no firi soro bɛkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ wɔn no. Saa nsɛm yi na abɔfoɔ mpo pɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛhunu mu.
Abrabɔ kronkron
13 # Luk 12.35 Enti mommɔ mo adwene mu abɔsoɔ, mo ani nna hɔ, na momma mo ani nna adom a wɔde rebrɛ mo Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu no so koraa. 14#Rom 12.2 Monyɛ sɛ asoɔmmerɛ mma, na monnyɛ mo ho sɛdeɛ kane a monnim biribiara no na mo akɔnnɔ teɛ no, 15na mmom te sɛ deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo no yɛ kronkron no, mo nso monyɛ kronkron abrabɔ nyinaa mu, 16#Lew 19.2 na wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Monyɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ me, meyɛ kronkron.
17 # Rom 2.11 Na sɛ mofrɛ deɛ ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na ɔbu atɛn sɛdeɛ obiara adwuma teɛ no sɛ Agya a, momfa suro mmɔ mo bra mo ahɔhobea tena bea yi mu, 18#1 Ko 6.20; 7.23; 1 Pe 4.3 sɛ monim sɛ wɔamfa nnoɔma a ɛporɔ, dwetɛ anaa sika annye mo amfiri mo abrabɔ hunu a mo agyanom de maa mo no mu, 19#Yes 53.7; Heb 9.14 na mmom wɔde Kristo a ɔte sɛ adwammaa a ɔnni dɛm ne nkekaeɛ no mogya a ne boɔ yɛ den no na ɛgyee mo. 20#Rom 16.25-26; Efe 1.4 Ɔno na wɔyii no sieeɛ ansa na wɔrehyɛ wiase aseɛ, na wɔayi no akyerɛ, berɛ a ɛdi akyire yi mu ama mo 21#Yoh 14.6 a monam ne so gye Onyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu na ɔhyɛɛ no animuonyam no die no, na mo gyidie ne anidasoɔ atena Nyankopɔn mu.
22Monte mo kra ho, nokorɛ setie mu, nkɔ onuadɔ a nkontompo nni mu mu, na momfiri akoma mu nnodɔ mo ho mo ho denden. 23#Yoh 1.13; Yak 1.18 Na wɔamfiri aba a ɛporɔ mu, na mmom wɔfiri deɛ ɛmporɔ mu, ɛne sɛ wɔnam Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɛte aseɛ na ɛbɛtena hɔ no so awo wɔn foforɔ. 24#Yes 40.6-7; Yak 1.10-11 Ɛfiri sɛ
honam nyinaa te sɛ wira,
na onipa animuonyam nyinaa te sɛ wira nhwiren.
Wira hye,
na ne nhwiren po;
25 # Yes 40.8 na Awurade asɛm deɛ, ɛte hɔ daa. Na yei ne asɛmpa a wɔaka akyerɛ mo no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Petro, Yesu Kristo somafoɔ, de kɔma wɔn a wɔahwete kɔ Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia ne Bitinia no mu, amamfrafoɔ a wɔayi wɔn, sɛdeɛ Agya Nyankopɔn nim a ɔnim dada no teɛ no, wɔ honhom ahoteɛ mu, de kɔ asoɔmmerɛ ne Yesu Kristo mogya dwira mu: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ mmorosoɔ nka mo.

Nhyira nka yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo Nyankopɔn ne Agya a ne mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso nti ɔnam Yesu Kristo sɔreɛ a ɔfiri awufoɔ mu sɔreeɛ no so awo yɛn foforɔ kɔ anidasoɔ a emu wɔ nkwa mu, ne apɛgyadeɛ a ɛmporɔ, na ɛho nni dɛm, na ɛmpa mu, a wɔde asie ɔsoro ama mo a wɔnam gyidie so wɛn mo wɔ Nyankopɔn tumi mu de kɔ nkwagyeɛ a wɔasiesie sɛ wɔrebɛyi no adie ɛberɛ a ɛdi akyire no mu.
Ɛno mu na mo ho siane mo, mo a nnansa yi, sɛ ɛsɛ a, wɔho mo werɛ kakra, sɔhwɛ ahodoɔ bebree mu, na wɔahunu mo gyidie tɔtorɔtɔɔ sɛ ne boɔ yɛ den pii sene sika, a wɔsɔ hwɛ ogya mu, nanso ɛsɛeɛ, ama ayeyie ne anidie ne animuonyam, Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu. Ɔno na monhunuu no, nanso modɔ no. Ɔno na monhunuu no seesei deɛ, nanso mogye no die, na mo ho siane mo anigyeɛ a ɛnni kabea a animuonyam wɔ mu mu, sɛ monya mo gyidie akatua a ɛne mo kra nkwagyeɛ no. Saa nkwagyeɛ no na adiyifoɔ a wɔhyɛɛ adom a ɛbɛba mo soɔ no ho nkɔm de too hɔ no, pɛeɛ na wɔpeepee mu. Wɔhwehwɛɛ berɛ ko ne berɛ ahodoɔ a Kristo honhom a ɛwɔ wɔn mu dii kan daa no adi faa n’amanehunu ne akyire animuonyam a ɛbɛba no ho.

Wɔyi kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, ɛnyɛ wɔn ho nko na wɔsom, na mmom wɔsom mo fa nsɛm a seesei yɛbɔ no dawuro kyerɛ mo ne wɔn a wɔnam Honhom Kronkron a wɔsomaa no firi soro bɛkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ wɔn no. Saa nsɛm yi na abɔfoɔ mpo pɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛhunu mu.

Enti mommɔ mo adwene mu abɔsoɔ, mo ani nna hɔ, na momma mo ani nna adom a wɔde rebrɛ mo Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu no so koraa. Monyɛ sɛ asoɔmmerɛ mma, na monnyɛ mo ho sɛdeɛ kane a monnim biribiara no na mo akɔnnɔ teɛ no, na mmom te sɛ deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo no yɛ kronkron no, mo nso monyɛ kronkron abrabɔ nyinaa mu, na wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Monyɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ me, meyɛ kronkron.
Na sɛ mofrɛ deɛ ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na ɔbu atɛn sɛdeɛ obiara adwuma teɛ no sɛ Agya a, momfa suro mmɔ mo bra mo ahɔhobea tena bea yi mu, sɛ monim sɛ wɔamfa nnoɔma a ɛporɔ, dwetɛ anaa sika annye mo amfiri mo abrabɔ hunu a mo agyanom de maa mo no mu, na mmom wɔde Kristo a ɔte sɛ adwammaa a ɔnni dɛm ne nkekaeɛ no mogya a ne boɔ yɛ den no na ɛgyee mo. Ɔno na wɔyii no sieeɛ ansa na wɔrehyɛ wiase aseɛ, na wɔayi no akyerɛ, berɛ a ɛdi akyire yi mu ama mo a monam ne so gye Onyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu na ɔhyɛɛ no animuonyam no die no, na mo gyidie ne anidasoɔ atena Nyankopɔn mu.
Monte mo kra ho, nokorɛ setie mu, nkɔ onuadɔ a nkontompo nni mu mu, na momfiri akoma mu nnodɔ mo ho mo ho denden. Na wɔamfiri aba a ɛporɔ mu, na mmom wɔfiri deɛ ɛmporɔ mu, ɛne sɛ wɔnam Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɛte aseɛ na ɛbɛtena hɔ no so awo wɔn foforɔ. Ɛfiri sɛ
honam nyinaa te sɛ wira,
na onipa animuonyam nyinaa te sɛ wira nhwiren.
Wira hye,
na ne nhwiren po;
na Awurade asɛm deɛ, ɛte hɔ daa. Na yei ne asɛmpa a wɔaka akyerɛ mo no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
